purpose: Check whether a supplied Pennsylvania vendor name, street address, and domain are mutually consistent with bounded public identity evidence.

decision_policy.consistent: All three identity checks pass, including address identity and vendor-name/domain alignment.
decision_policy.human_review: Any required check is failed, unavailable, uncertain, or contradictory.

claim_boundaries: consistent means only that the supplied identifiers agree with the configured public evidence checks
it does not prove domain ownership or control
it does not prove control of a physical address
it does not establish good standing, authority to contract, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
